# Smokestack Detector Preregistration

## Immutable identity

- Detector ID/version:
- Code commit SHA:
- Config digest:
- Schema digests:
- Universe ID:
- Preregistration timestamp:
- Calibration trial-ledger digest:

## Hypothesis

One falsifiable primary hypothesis.

## Primary endpoint

Exactly one primary endpoint, including time horizon and calculation rule.

## Minimum useful effect

Define the minimum effect size worth product/research continuation. Do not substitute statistical significance alone.

## Secondary/descriptive endpoints

List explicitly. State any multiplicity correction if confirmatory claims will be made.

## Eligibility

- Universe rule:
- Source qualification identities:
- Knowledge-time rule:
- Formation eligibility:
- Attention eligibility:
- Missingness/ineligibility behavior:

## Detector

Exact deterministic rule and reason-code mapping.

## Baselines

Define trivial/name/deployer/other baseline algorithms without outcome-informed edits.

## Controls

Define contemporaneous control selection using pre-outcome variables only.

## Sample size / precision

State calculation, assumptions and target N/event count.

## Stopping rule

State when the prospective cohort closes. No discretionary early closure for a good-looking result unless preregistered.

## Invalidating conditions

Examples: discovered lookahead path, source semantic drift affecting decision meaning, corrupted/incomplete required source coverage.

## Adjudication rule

Mechanical conditions for `ADVANCE | PIVOT | KILL`.

## Prohibited changes after start

Threshold changes, manual outcome-aware suppression, source substitution, endpoint substitution, control redesign and semantic bug fixes under the same detector version.
